title: Coproduct summands of fixed-coefficient tensor pullback
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, p:X→Y a morphism of schemes, and P,Q arbitrary cochain complexes of sheaves of ULift(R)-modules on the small pro-etale site of Y. Write A for fixed-coefficient inverse image and t for the specified total tensor pullback comparison [def-sf-finite-scalar-complex-tensor-pullback]. For all integers a+b=n, the map A(ι_{a,b}) followed by t(P,Q).f n equals the ordinary oplax tensorator δ_A(P.X a,Q.X b) followed by the (a,b) injection into the total tensor of A(P),A(Q). No flatness or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: For an abstract additive monoidal left adjoint, rewrite the app of the total comparison to its native mapBifunctorComparison, and apply HomologicalComplex.map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX. Specialize first to sheaves over an abstract coefficient category, then to the actual module coefficients, preserving all native monoidal data. Every step is proved in Lean, without sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullback_ι (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).map
        (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _) a b n h) ≫
      ((finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullbackForCoefficients
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app (P, Q)).f n =
    Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
        (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p) (P.X a) (Q.X b) ≫
      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q) (curriedTensor _) a b n h
